name: RC-B10-0366/2025 – After § 7 – Am 7
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Colombia after the wave of recent terrorist attacks
part_text: 7a. Stresses that the root causes of the Colombian conflict derive from inequality, and therefore welcomes the Government’s efforts to reduce inequality and ensure universal access to public services and social rights; highlights that the Peace Agreement also encompassed measures aimed at addressing the structural causes of the conflict and it is therefore essential to underscore once again the importance of its full implementation;
